ruling.recommended_action: Issue Ryde voucher of $5.79 to rider (metered-extra-distance refund for the unexempted mid-trip detour); + flag_account

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 21:46:45–22:13:45: GPS departs the quoted C2/PIE alignment near (1.32017,103.87862) and runs ~6–8 km through the western perpendicular, with a reversal/overshoot to ~103.930 before rejoining, adding ≈1.5 km of driven distance. No RD-4 exemption: the sole Accident incident lies ON the quoted alignment the driver actually used (m_from_route ≈ 0), and the only band overlapping the quoted corridor is band 4 (30–39 km/h), not band 1/2. No RD-3/RD-5 exemption: no chat routing request or pre-departure agreement exists (chat only greets at 21:33/21:34; detour starts ~21:46). RD-1 duty breached; unexempted under RD-2 → metered extra distance refundable.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver claims a KPE accident forced his diversion, but the LTA incident at (1.31532,103.87453) is located on the quoted route he actually drove, not on any substituted section of the optimal route (RD-4(a) requires the traffic record to justify the replaced segment).

RD-5 requires the driver to propose the route change and the rider to agree BEFORE leaving the optimal route; the chat contains only pickup greetings (21:33/21:34), none of them a routing agreement, and the detour starts ~21:46.
